column1: # Single-gNB variant of gnbs-ret.csv for the playground capacity experiment:
# only gnb_south is kept so RET tilt/bearing/beamforming changes on this one
# cell can be isolated without a second cell absorbing/handing over UEs.
# z = local terrain height + 25m mast (same source position as gnbs-ret.csv).
# bearing_deg/tilt_deg columns are intentionally omitted here too -- the
# scenario code parses but does not apply them at startup (see
# khu-real-nr-sionna.cc:21); set RET via xapp_ret_ctrl at runtime instead
# or via --ns3::NrHelper::... / a future explicit init-tilt flag.
